entity.name: Alipay denies supporting crypto trading after Peer platform lists it as payment method
entity.description: Chinese payments giant Alipay has publicly denied supporting cryptocurrency trading through third-party platforms after peer-to-peer marketplace Peer announced a beta service allowing users to buy and sell USDC using Alipay. Peer's website continues to display Alipay as a payment option despite the company stating there is no official partnership.

toEntity.name: Peer's trade process releases escrowed USDC to a buyer's wallet upon verification of direct Alipay yuan transfer or returns funds after a 6-hour order window expires.
Alipay operates internal monitoring procedures designed to detect, track, and suspend accounts involved in over-the-counter or peer-to-peer cryptocurrency transactions.
Under Peer's trading mechanism, USDC sellers deposit tokens into an onchain smart contract escrow on the Base network prior to transaction completion.
Using payment channels like Alipay for cryptocurrency transactions in China carries risks of account suspension and loss of funds.
Alipay has previously issued public denials and rejected third-party associations with cryptocurrency transactions in 2019 and 2024.
